sources: Owner-approved twin-valley story and art plan, 17 November 2026
name: The visiting herder

lines.text: The goats graze beyond the approach. We leave the threshold free even when the shade is good.
A wide shadow once crossed the western sand without a footstep. I cannot promise you when a beedu will rise again.
I bring the animals here for rest, then move with the grazing. Yamantaka keeps the fold ready between visits.
You saw it rise, then. My old report and your own sighting belong on different lines of the page.

notes: Intermittent helper, alternating with the cook; no new culture or random traveller pool.
